brief.text: BORR represents the day's largest cluster value at $81.9 million across two insiders, well ahead of COHR at $51.1 million and BPRE at $41.7 million. BBT stands out with four participating insiders, the highest count on the dashboard, while Saba Capital Management dominates individual filings across four distinct funds, including $3.9 million in DXYZ and $2.3 million in MXF. Meanwhile, IESC drew multiple individual transactions, led by a director filing of $653,000 alongside a $41,150 commitment from its president and CEO.
